steps.title: List project directory and check tooling
Check npm name availability and headless browsers

body.command: for n in dotpals fluffpals dot-pals; do printf "%s: " $n; npm view $n name 2>&1 | head -1; done; ls "/c/Program Files (x86)/Microsoft/Edge/Application/msedge.exe" "/c/Program Files/Google/Chrome/Application/chrome.exe" 2>&1

steps.title: Apply small fixes to element file

body.command:
cd /c/Dot/src && python - <<'EOF'
import re
p='element.js'; s=open(p,encoding='utf8').read()
s=s.replace("  #uid = `dp${++uid}`;","  #n = ++uid;\n  #uid = `dp${this.#n}`;")
s=s.replace("const seed = (uid * 7) % 97;","const seed = (this.#n * 7) % 97;")
s=s.replace("  .dp-idle, .dp-actor { transform-origin: 50% 100%; }\n  .dp-actor { perspective: 600px; }","  .dp-idle, .dp-actor { transform-origin: 50% 100%; }\n  .dp-idle { perspective: 600px; }")
s=s.replace(").finished.finally(() => p.remove());",").finished.catch(() => {}).finally(() => p.remove());")
open(p,'w',encoding='utf8').write(s)
EOF
grep -n "#n\b\|perspective\|p.remove" element.js

steps.title: Serve demo and take headless screenshot

body.command: cd /c/Dot && (PORT=5199 node scripts/serve.js > /dev/null 2>&1 &) ; sleep 1; OUT="$(cygpath -w "$TMP")"; SP='~\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\c--Dot\00000000-0000\scratchpad'; "/c/Program Files/Google/Chrome/Application/chrome.exe" --headless=new --disable-gpu --hide-scrollbars --force-prefers-reduced-motion --window-size=1000,1100 --virtual-time-budget=2000 --screenshot="$SP\\shot1.png" http://localhost:5199/ 2>&1 | tail -2

steps.title: Run API smoke test in headless Chrome
Rewrite smoke test to log incrementally and rerun

body.command: sed -i "s|const out = \[\]; const log = (m) => out.push(m);|const log = (m) => document.getElementById('out').textContent += m + '\\\\n';|; s|^document.getElementById('out').textContent = out.join.*$|log('done');|; s|await Promise.all(DotPal.actions.map(a => p.play(a)));|log('actions=' + DotPal.actions); DotPal.actions.forEach(a => p.play(a)); log('played');|; s|await p.play('pop')|p.play('pop')|; s|await p.play('nope')|p.play('nope')|" demo/_test.html && grep -n "log = \|played\|done" demo/_test.html && "/c/Program Files/Google/Chrome/Application/chrome.exe" --headless=new --virtual-time-budget=4000 --dump-dom http://localhost:5199/demo/_test.html 2>/dev/null | sed -n '/<pre id="out">/,/<\/pre>/p'

body.command: npm pack --dry-run 2>&1 | grep -E "npm notice [0-9.]+k?B|total files|package size"; taskkill //F //IM node.exe //FI "WINDOWTITLE eq *" >/dev/null 2>&1; powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter \"Name='node.exe'\" | Where-Object { \$_.CommandLine -like '*serve.js*' } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id \$_.ProcessId -Force }"; echo stopped
